headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 19, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jared Jones leading the way on the mound. Jacob Gonzalez also had a standout performance at the plate, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 2 runs. In other action, the Chicago Cubs cruised past the Minnesota Twins 6-2, with Matthew Boyd earning the win.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with Justin Sterner of the Athletics being placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right knee chondromalacia diagnosis. Other players on the injured list include Lourdes Gurriel Jr. of the Arizona Diamondbacks, Jeff Criswell of the Colorado Rockies, Sal Frelick of the Milwaukee Brewers, Oneil Cruz of the Pittsburgh Pirates, Chris Bassitt of the Baltimore Orioles, and JoJo Romero of the St. Louis Cardinals.

The Chicago Cubs have made a significant trade, acquiring right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett. The Baltimore Orioles also made a trade, acquiring right fielder Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals for cash.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Guardians 7-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 7-1 victory over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jared Jones leading the way on the mound. Jacob Gonzalez also had a standout performance at the plate, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Guardians Take Down Pirates in Thrilling 5-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 3-5 win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Cade Smith earning the win. Travis Bazzana led the Guardians' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including a key 8th-inning homer that scored Steven Kwan.

top_news.title: **Cubs Cruise Past Twins 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 6-2 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Matthew Boyd earning the win. Kody Clemens led the Twins' offense with two home runs and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Mets Fall to Phillies in 6-1 Loss**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets suffered a 6-1 defeat at the hands of the Philadelphia Phillies. Jesús Luzardo earned the win for the Phillies, pitching 5.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Athletics RHP Justin Sterner Placed on 15-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Athletics right-handed pitcher Justin Sterner has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right knee chondromalacia diagnosis. The injury occurred on July 18, 2026.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Aaron Civale in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics in exchange for right-handed pitcher Aiden Moffett.
